the construction, commissioning, and characterization of electromagnetic calorimeters for high-energy physics.
the development and implementation of lead-glass electromagnetic sampling calorimeters for the measurement of electron/hadron separations in the energy range between 1 and 5 GeV.
the development of a new calorimeter for the Super High Momentum Magnet (SHMS) in Hall C at the Jefferson Lab (JLab) in Newport News, Virginia.
